svg.title: Cecil tests seven source cards beside Riju's terminal as Vale observes.
svg.desc: Inside the cramped server cupboard, seven blank source cards enter separate slots. Cecil processes them through Riju's terminal while Vale insists that every source be included and the original maps remain visible in the archive.
